p3_b4.ocr: Equipment efficiency metrics suggest a consistent operational capability throughout the year. This data collectively underscores SK Hynix's commitment to enhancing its semiconductor production capabilities while maintaining competitive cost efficiency and yield performance relative to industry standards.
